claims.claim: BlackSky reported continued international adoption of Gen-3, including an August seven-figure multi-year subscription expansion following a pilot; Q2 space-based intelligence and AI services revenue reached a record $25M.

factors.name: real-time geospatial intelligence adoption
factors.basis: pilot-to-subscription conversion and record intelligence-services revenue support operational demand for low-latency Gen-3 imagery and analytics

risks.risk: Revenue remains exposed to government procurement timing and constellation deployment execution.

causalEdges.from: defense demand for low-latency tactical ISR
causalEdges.mechanism: higher-resolution rapid-revisit imagery plus analytics supports time-sensitive monitoring workflows
causalEdges.falsifier: pilot conversions slow materially or Gen-3 utilization fails to scale

unknowns.unknown: Customer concentration and renewal economics by major international program require underwriting.

claims.claim: Q2 2026 revenue was $33.3M, up 50% year over year; adjusted EBITDA was $4.7M versus a loss in Q2 2025, and cash/restricted cash/short-term investments were $244.1M after $150M of ATM equity issuance.

factors.name: execution and operating leverage
factors.basis: revenue growth and positive adjusted EBITDA show improving operating contribution from Gen-3 services

risks.risk: The stronger cash balance partly reflects $150M of ATM equity issuance, creating dilution that must be separated from operating cash generation.

causalEdges.mechanism: subscription/service mix adds contribution while cash operating expenses remain comparatively controlled
causalEdges.falsifier: service revenue grows without sustained EBITDA or cash-flow improvement

unknowns.unknown: No valuation conclusion is asserted; dilution-adjusted per-share economics remain to be underwritten.
